verdict.rationale: Evidence shows per-item disposal choice (opt to have mail not opened/scanned and shipped directly, or scanned via automation rules) [virtualpostmail-docs-9, virtualpostmail-docs-19, virtualpostmail-docs-17], giving the operator some control over physical mail handling. However, there is no documentation of storage duration windows or on-request shredding with confirmation. Missing for 10: documented storage/retention windows, shredding request workflow, and confirmation of destruction.
